title: Continuity of the radial cutoff pairing s -> integral phi(|x - y|/s)(x - y).H dmu (Simon Ch. 4, 4.3-4.4)
statement: Let n, l be natural numbers, E := R^{n+l} (Euclidean space), mu a measure on E, H : E -> E, y in E, phi : R -> R and S, T, t real numbers. Write r(x) := |x - y| and B_S(y) for the closed ball of radius S about y. Assume: T > 0; H is mu-integrable on B_S(y); phi is continuous; phi(u) = 0 for every u >= T; t > 0; and T t < S. Then the function L(s) := integral_E phi(r(x)/s) ((x - y).H(x)) dmu(x) is continuous at s = t. Here L is a Bochner integral with the real inner product, and division follows Lean's convention x/0 = 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) (H : Amb n ℓ → Amb n ℓ) (y : Amb n ℓ) (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (S T t : ℝ), 0 < T → IntegrableOn H (closedBall y S) μ → Continuous φ → (∀ u : ℝ, T ≤ u → φ u = 0) → 0 < t → T * t < S → ContinuousAt (fun s => ∫ x, φ (‖x - y‖ / s) * inner ℝ (x - y) (H x) ∂μ) t
